terms.definition: The body's largest organ - a protective outer covering.
terms.function: Protects, senses touch, controls temperature, and repairs itself.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the body's first line of defense.

terms.definition: The thin protective outer layer of skin.
terms.function: Protects and constantly replaces its cells.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the surface that takes the daily wear.

terms.definition: The thick inner layer of the skin.
terms.whyItMatters: It gives the skin strength and its senses.

terms.definition: A gland in the dermis that releases sweat.
terms.whereItIs: In the dermis, opening to the surface.
terms.whyItMatters: It is key to staying cool.
